title: Uvogin's Death Reaches the Troupe Part 4

cuts.voiceover_text: Uvogin's eye stays open after Kurapika turns away. For one horrible second, it looks like the fight still has one move left. But the body never rises. Kurapika stands over the fallen fighter, and the victory on his face feels nothing like triumph. He looks drained. The red glow above the ruined valley hangs in the darkness, almost like a warning. Then it fades. The battlefield disappears, replaced by a city under the moon. The camera drops past the rooftops and finds a shattered building below. In the crater, several people stand around a shadowed figure. They are not celebrating. They are watching the center of the room, waiting for the consequences of a death that has just reached them.

Inside the ruined room, the group closes in. A woman in a dark coat stands with one hand on her hip, while a black-haired woman watches through round glasses. Across from them, bruised and bandaged fighters stand shoulder to shoulder. Kurapika appears at the edge of the group, silent among the people who came with him. Their attention turns toward the woman in the fur collar. She sits in the rubble and smiles as if she already knows how this ends. The camera moves across the faces, then settles on Kurapika. He looks young, but the room treats him like someone who has crossed a line. Then the mood changes. A masked figure and a red-haired woman fill the frame. Beyond them, in the cold blue light, a pale man with a star on his face leans against the wall. Hisoka is here. Uvogin is dead, but the next question is worse: why has Hisoka entered the room now?

series.summary: Kurapika leaves Uvogin dead as a tense gathering reveals Hisoka's arrival.
